description: A utility class for generating and validating JWT tokens asserting device registration status, handling key management and token expiration.

classes.name: JwtHelper
classes.description: An abstract utility class for creating and verifying JWT tokens related to device registration, supporting key management and token expiration checks.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Converts a secret string into a UTF-8 encoded byte array.

methods.name: setSharedSecret
methods.description: Sets a shared secret key for signing tokens, must be at least 32 bytes.

methods.name: setPrivateKey
methods.description: Loads an RSA or EC private key from a file for signing tokens.

methods.name: setPublicKey
methods.description: Loads a public key from a certificate file for validating tokens.

methods.name: getTokenLifetime
methods.description: Returns the configured duration for token expiration.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if a given token is expired, considering clock skew.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Extracts the expiration date ('exp' claim) from a JWT token.
